<title level="1" pfs="">[Desert Manticore](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3299)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Desert manticores are far more dangerous than their common cousins and only marginally cleverer. Instead of the usually spiked tail reminiscent of a porcupine, desert manticores have large scorpion tails, requiring them to adopt closer approaches and cunning ambushes. Desert manticores are known for their egos and constant attempts to outmatch [sphinxes](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=209) within their chosen territories. No accounts of such attempts have ever proved fruitful for the desert manticore.

<trait label="Beast" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=547" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 172

**Perception** +22; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 60 feet

**Languages**
[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Kelish](/Languages.aspx?ID=38), [Osiriani](/Languages.aspx?ID=40)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) +22, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +25, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=38) +22, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) +26, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) +22

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +7

**Dex** +2

**Con** +5

**Int** -2

**Wis** +2

**Cha** +4
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 33 

**Fort** +25 

**Ref** +22 

**Will** +22 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 270

</row>

**Immunities**
[poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669)

**Indomitable Beast** <actions string="Reaction" /> **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** The desert manticore is reduced to 0 HP; **Effect** The desert manticore avoids being knocked out and remains at 1 HP, then can make a stinger Strike against a creature in its reach.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 30 feet, fly 40 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
jaws +25,
**Damage** 4d8+10 piercing plus [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45)

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
claw +25 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170)),
**Damage** 4d6+10 slashing

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
stinger +25 ([reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)),
**Damage** 3d6+10 piercing plus manticore venom

**Manticore Venom**  ([Poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126)) **Saving Throw** Fortitude DC 32; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 3d8 poison damage and [drained 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68) (1 round); **Stage 2** 4d8 poison damage and drained 2 (1 round); **Stage 3** 5d8 poison damage and drained 3 (1 round)

**Scorpion Sting** <actions string="Two Actions" />  The desert manticore Strikes an [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) creature with its stinger. The attack injects venom deeply, dealing an additional 4d8 poison damage and giving the target a –2 circumstance penalty to their initial save against the poison.

**Venomous Flight** <actions string="Two Actions" />  The desert manticore [Flies](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312) twice, dripping venom from its stinger. It chooses a creature it flew directly above during the flight, which is exposed to manticore venom. The desert manticore cannot fly further than 60 feet above the target or the venom becomes too dispersed in fall to take effect.

</column>
